text:
Type: slim black poster frame
Use: displaying a poster, print or photo on a wall; living room, home office, bedroom, hallway
Style: minimalist, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: thin black metal frame, clear protective front, grey insert board
Colors: black, light grey
Shape: tall portrait rectangle with a very narrow flat profile, edge-to-edge display area, large but visually light, sits flat to the wall
Feel: clean, crisp, graphic, gallery-like
Goes with: white or light grey walls, black accents, art prints and posters; minimalist, Scandinavian or industrial rooms

product.name: STRMBY
product.description: Can be hung horizontally or vertically to fit in the space available.
